messages.content: Return concise executable Python 3 only. Print the final integer, or UNSOLVABLE if contradictory/impossible. No comments, Markdown, explanations or file writes. Avoid unnecessary functions; prefer built-ins and short expressions.
A shipment has 17 boxes of 24 screws and 13 boxes of 18 screws. Exactly 27 screws are damaged. How many usable screws remain? Write only the integer result to answer.txt.
